request.description: Constructs and previews the exact dynamic LLM scorecard prompt without executing evaluation, using the tenant's default criteria configuration.
Previews the prompt using custom criteria explicitly provided in the request body.
Evaluates a call transcript against default tenant criteria defined in criteria_config.json. Fallback loads all 11 standard criteria.
Evaluates with 3 omitted criteria ('Branding and Survey Check', 'Verified customer', and 'Paraphrasing'). Demonstrates dynamic criteria selection and dynamic category weight normalization.
